_comment: Optional per-project config. Place at project root as guardian.config.json. All fields are optional — auto-detection is used for anything not specified. Not shown below: "tsconfig" (e.g. "web/tsconfig.json") — path to your tsconfig relative to the project root; set it only when there is no tsconfig.json at the root. excludeDirectories adds to the built-in list (node_modules, dist, .claude, cdk.out, build, __snapshots__, .next, .turbo, coverage, .venv, __pycache__, .pytest_cache, site-packages, .mypy_cache, .ruff_cache), which always applies, so list only project-specific folders: a bare name matches at any depth, an entry with a slash matches that one path from the project root; patterns with * are not supported. A wrong value anywhere in this file stops rebuild_index before it changes anything, and the result lists what to fix.

searchHint._comment: Nudge Claude toward the semantic `search` tool when it greps. enabled: on/off; rearmAfter: grep searches without a semantic search before re-nudging; stalenessThreshold: changed files since last index build before suggesting a rebuild.
